preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 20.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Each test case has a sequence length between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**5 <= ai <= 10**5 for ai in as_list)
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence is between -100,000 and 100,000.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all('YES' if any(a[i] == bj - bk for bj in b for bk in b) for i in range(n)) if output[i] == 'YES' else True for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', there exists a sequence b such that for each a[i], there exist indices j and k such that a[i] = b[j] - b[k].

postconditions.expression: all('NO' if not any(a[i] == bj - bk for bj in b for bk in b) for i in range(n)) if output[i] == 'NO' else True for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'NO', there does not exist any sequence b satisfying the condition.
